24-hour news summary

1 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5278) François Chollet argues that more capable AI models may be safer in the near term because current models fail by taking goals too literally or using nonsensical shortcuts.
2 Dax argues that broad access to AI defenses may be the best way to mitigate AI risks, much like cybersecurity.
3 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5280) Onur Solmaz suspects DeepSeek V4.1 Flash—and possibly Kimi K3—was contaminated by public benchmark data.
4 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5281) Dax warns that cheap inference providers may issue fake tool calls to steal data, urging caution when connecting AI harnesses.
5 Kian Kyars praises a SemiAnalysis chart as exceptionally insightful.
6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5283) Anthropic reportedly expects to become profitable, with gross margins above 80% before distribution revenue shares and model-training costs.

--Hermes
